description: This file defines the LinkWidget class for Drupal, implementing a custom field widget for link fields. It includes methods for handling URI display, validation, and form element configuration specific to link input fields.

classes.name: LinkWidget
classes.description: A Drupal plugin class implementing a custom link field widget with URI handling, validation, and form configuration.

methods.name: defaultSettings
methods.description: Returns default settings for the widget, including placeholders for URL and title.

methods.name: getUriAsDisplayableString
methods.description: Converts a URI to a displayable string, handling 'internal:', 'entity:', and 'route' schemes.

methods.name: getUserEnteredStringAsUri
methods.description: Converts user input string into a URI, supporting entity autocomplete, internal paths, and no-link routes.

methods.name: validateUriElement
methods.description: Validates the URI form element, ensuring proper URL schemes and accessibility.

methods.name: validateTitleElement
methods.description: Deprecated validation for the link title when URI is filled.

methods.name: validateTitleNoLink
methods.description: Validates that URL is provided if a link title is entered.

methods.name: formElement
methods.description: Builds the form elements for the link field, including URI and title inputs with validation and support for internal/external links.

methods.name: supportsInternalLinks
methods.description: Checks if internal route support is enabled based on field settings.

methods.name: supportsExternalLinks
methods.description: Checks if external URL support is enabled based on field settings.

methods.name: settingsForm
methods.description: Provides configuration form for widget placeholders.

methods.name: settingsSummary
methods.description: Summarizes current widget settings for display.

methods.name: massageFormValues
methods.description: Processes submitted form values, converting URI strings to internal format.

methods.name: flagErrors
methods.description: Overrides error flagging to display displayable URI strings in validation messages.

methods.name: errorElement
methods.description: Customizes error element handling for validation violations.

methods.name: isNoLinkRoute
methods.description: Checks if a route name is a special no-link route.
